overview: This House resolution assigns Representatives to two House committees: Ms. Ross, Mr. Ivey, Ms. Garcia of Texas, and Mr. Subramanyam to the Committee on Ethics, which investigates possible misconduct by House members and staff, and Mr. Carter of Louisiana and Mr. Garcia of California to the Committee on Homeland Security, which oversees the Department of Homeland Security and related issues. Resolutions like this are the routine way each party's choices for committee seats are formally approved by the full House. It does not change any law or policy. The House agreed to it on March 11, 2025.
for: Supporters say filling these seats lets the Ethics and Homeland Security committees operate with full membership for the new Congress.
against: Critics say this is a routine housekeeping measure that only fills committee seats and doesn't change any law or spending.
